results.content: Each week, students in this project will take part in research activities that move. Dr. Law is deploying a mixed-methods research project that seeks to understand how first-year students use generative AI tools like ChatGPT and Microsoft CoPilot in their academic writing. First-Year Scholars will serve as co-researchers and co-creators within the project team, working alongside faculty, staff, and graduate students. While the primary focus on participation on this project will be to help First Year Scholars gain research skills applicable to a variety of academic circumstances, there are other goals which will also be supported and scaffolded by this work. In this project, you’ll help find out by exploring the first-year experience from two perspectives: your own as a student living it and a researcher’s view of campus-wide patterns. Each week, students will engage in structured research activities designed to gradually build their skills, contribute to the project’s goals, and foster collaboration.
